query: DELETE FROM sources AS s WHERE (s.tenant_id, s.id) IN (SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::uuid[])) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_links AS l WHERE l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.source_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operation_sources AS g WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.source_id = s.id)
